description: This file defines a HomeFragment class for an Android TV application using Leanback library. It creates a UI with a top navigation bar, background management, and content rows with cards representing media items. It also manages focus handling and background display on item selection.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment handling the home screen UI with multiple content rows, background, and top navigation.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data model for media content cards, holding id, title, description, and image resource.

classes.name: HeroCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter extending Presenter to display media cards with focus effects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup, preparing background and listeners.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI elements, title, and content rows after view creation.

methods.name: prepareBackground
methods.description: Initializes and attaches the background manager, sets default background.

methods.name: setupUIAndTitleSafely
methods.description: Configures title and header styles, builds top navigation once views are ready.

methods.name: buildTopNavBarIfReady
methods.description: Checks if TitleView is available, then sets up the top navigation labels.

methods.name: setTitlePaddingForTV
methods.description: Adjusts padding for large TV text and safe display.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Creates and adds content rows to the adapter.

methods.name: buildCardRow
methods.description: Constructs a ListRow with a header and list of CardItems.

methods.name: sampleItems
methods.description: Generates sample CardItem list for demonstration.

methods.name: onItemClicked
methods.description: Handles item click events (placeholder for navigation).

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Updates background when a new item is selected.
